ideal: Every search asked before any scenario is known to be impossible leaves no unit out.
When a scenario of any unit names a word, the checker reports no unit's formula as lone on that word.
note: two numbered units become 'any unit' and 'no unit'

ideal: The checker names every unit that is held with units that cannot all hold in its report of a contradiction.

The checker reports a unit's formula as lone on a word only if no other formula can contradict that formula. Conversely, when a unit that is not a term holds a formula that no other formula can contradict, the checker reports that formula as lone on some signature.
note: the two halves said as 'only if' and 'conversely'

ideal: When a quantifier's reading says the variable twice, the verbalizer says the quantifier in full, with "there is" and the numbered name.
A unit's statement is handwritten when the unit holds a formula that can be said in words and its statement does not sit between the markers of a generated region.
note: four conditions merged into one sentence

ideal: A statement that sits between the markers of a generated region is current when its unit's formula can be said in words and the statement does not differ from what that formula says.
note: the generated region becomes the subject

ideal: The checker cannot read a dangling frontmatter.
When a unit that is not a term declares a word, that word counts as a word declared in a unit that is not a term.
note: the fixed reading of the conclusion repeats the condition, so the claim sounds circular in words; 'counts as' marks it as a classification

ideal: It must be possible for a quantifier both to have its variable said once by the sentence and to have a condition that is not about its variable.
When a quantifier's variable has a further condition and the quantifier fits a noun phrase, the verbalizer says it with a relative clause, such as "a unit that is a spec".
It must be possible for a definition to have alternatives all of one kind and also an alternative that says something about another unit.
When a unit that is not a term holds a formula that is lone on a signature, the checker reports that formula as lone on that signature.
note: three conditions merged into one clause

ideal: When the sentence says a quantifier's variable once and the quantifier fits a noun phrase, the verbalizer says the quantifier as a noun phrase in the place of the variable, such as "sits in no unit".
It must be possible for a list to be a rule whose two sides are each one clause and whose first side begins with a time phrase.
The checker reports a unit's formula as lone on a word only when the unit holds a formula and is not a term, the word is a signature, and the formula is lone on it.
From now on, whenever a call enters an owner that pulse has disposed, a call is throwing right after.
When a document keeps no readings, the checker reports no formula of a unit it holds as lone on any word.
note: three quantifiers folded into the sentence

ideal: It must be possible for a list to have both a clause about a pair of variables and an item that is more than one clause.
The checker reports a cycle for every circular unit.
The checker reports no untesting for a claim that some test the project declares checks.
The checker runs every plugin over every document it applies to, and runs a plugin over a document it does not apply to only when the command line of a run names that document.
note: second half turned into 'only when' the command line names it

ideal: The checker reports a mislocation for every claim that names a site no source holds.
When a definition has an alternative that does not begin with its kind, the verbalizer says the definition as a list of the alternatives as they stand.
When a unit holds a formula with no keyword, the analyzer is asked to hold that formula.
note: 'that formula' for the repeated noun phrase

ideal: The checker cannot read a stray frontmatter.
A run exits with code 0 when it gets neither code 1 nor code 2 from any plugin.
A unit is circular exactly when it cites a unit that depends on it.
The checker reports a freelancing for every exception that cites no spec.
When the project has no runner, the checker reports no untesting for any unit.
The checker reports a misnesting for every bug that cites a unit that is not a spec.
A conflict is paired exactly when it names two different units.
note: 'two different units' for 'a unit and another unit'

ideal: The checker reports an overreach for every test that checks a refined claim.
note: 'a refined claim' for 'a claim that is refined'

ideal:
Suppose a term declares a word, a reading in that term says the word, and a claim, a definition or a fact of some unit uses it. Then the checker does not report the word, and the word is none of these:
- a word that a reading says and nothing declares
- a word declared in a unit that is not a term
- a word whose reading is in another unit than its declaration
- a word that no claim, definition or fact uses
note: 'none of these' factors out four negations

ideal: When a quantifier says no variable differs from another and holds a condition, the verbalizer says it in full, with "there is" and the numbered name.
Whenever pulse disposes an owner, every cleanup on that owner that code has registered and that has not run has run, then or at some later moment.
A run that asks for a logic command does not exit with code 0 if the checker reports that some scenario cannot happen, or if some unit is held with units that cannot all hold.
note: the request folded into the subject

ideal: It must be possible for a quantifier whose variable the sentence says once also to say no variable differs from another and hold a condition.

Whenever pulse disposes an owner, take any two cleanups on that owner that code has registered and that have not run: the one code registered later runs, then or later, and the earlier one does not run before that.

Whenever a failing cleanup on an owner that pulse has disposed runs, the dispose of that owner is never stopped, then or afterwards.
note: 'until' said as 'runs, then or later, and the earlier one does not run before that'
